design_gotchas.title: CRITICAL PINOUT TRAP: Completely Incompatible With TPS54302DDCR, TPS563201DDCR & AP62200WU-7!
design_gotchas.detail: Despite sharing an identical 6-pin TSOT-23 / SOT-23-6 footprint, AP63203WU-7 uses 1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST — completely scrambled relative to TPS54302DDCR, TPS563201DDCR, and Diodes' own AP62200WU-7 (which all use 1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=FB, 5=EN, 6=BST). Never drop one onto the other's PCB pads!

design_gotchas.title: Fixed 3.3 V Output Only (Tie Pin 1 FB Directly to VOUT) — Not Adjustable
design_gotchas.detail: AP63203WU-7 is a fixed 3.3 V device whose Pin 1 (FB) connects directly to VOUT without external feedback resistors (AP63200/AP63201 are the adjustable 0.8 V VREF variants, and AP63205 is fixed 5.0 V). Putting a resistor divider on AP63203 FB shifts or destabilizes VOUT.

design_gotchas.title: 1.1 MHz Switching Frequency Differs From 500 kHz Siblings AP63200/AP63201
design_gotchas.detail: Fixed-output AP63203/AP63205 run at 1.1 MHz (requiring a smaller 3.9 uH inductor), whereas adjustable AP63200/AP63201 in the exact same datasheet run at 500 kHz. Verify inductor core loss at 1.1 MHz and note the +/-6% frequency spread spectrum (FSS) for EMI.

design_gotchas.title: 2 A Continuous Rating (vs 3 A on TPS54302/TPS563201) Despite Higher 32 V Input Rating
design_gotchas.detail: AP63203WU-7 offers superior 32 V input range (35 V DC / 40 V 400 ms), 35 V-tolerant EN pin, and ultra-low 22 uA PFM Iq, but is limited to 2 A continuous output (2.8 A typ HS peak limit) vs 3 A on TPS54302DDCR.

typical_use_cases: 24 V industrial automation, PLC, and building control rails stepped down directly to fixed 3.3 V up to 2 A
Ultra-low-Iq (22 uA) always-on 12 V/24 V battery-powered IoT gateways and smart appliances
EMI-sensitive compact 3.3 V point-of-load buck leveraging 1.1 MHz FSS and zero external feedback resistors
engineering_summary: The AP63203WU-7 is a 3.8 V to 32 V input (35 V DC / 40 V transient abs max), 2 A continuous fixed 3.3 V synchronous buck converter in TSOT-23-6 (TSOT26) with 22 uA ultra-low PFM Iq, 1.1 MHz switching with +/-6% FSS, and a 35 V-tolerant float-to-enable EN pin (~92% peak efficiency at 12 V -> 3.3 V). CRITICAL LAYOUT WARNING: Its pinout (1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST) is completely incompatible with TPS54302DDCR, TPS563201DDCR, and Diodes' own AP62200WU-7; always verify PCB footprint and fixed-3.3 V FB wiring in the official Diodes datasheet before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.1 and p.2 confirmed TSOT26 Top View pinout (1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST) — explicitly distinct from TPS54302/TPS563201/AP62200 — and fixed 3.3 V FB-to-VOUT wiring.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.2 Fig 2 confirmed AP63203 peak efficiency ~92% at VIN = 12 V, VOUT = 3.3 V.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.3 and p.4 confirmed Abs Max 35 V (40 V 400 ms), EN 35 V tolerant, Rec Op VIN 3.8-32 V, TA -40 to 85 C, RthetaJA 89 C/W, and RthetaJC 39 C/W.
